Evan Cho: FYI VoltWorks (acct VW-87) flagged: INV-5120 for $42,300 is 28 days past due. AM says theyre disputing April embedding spike charges.
Priya Nair: Do we have the dispute details? Line items?
Liam O'Connor: Received dispute email from their FP&A: they claim 1) duplicate batch ingestion on Apr 5, 2) unexpected embedding retention. Attached their CSV and screenshots.
Evan Cho: Has ops validated the duplicate ingestion? If so, we might issue a credit. If not, propose temporary credit hold while we investigate.
Liam O'Connor: Ops checked logs: there was a retry storm from their integration between 04:04-04:09 that generated ~1.1M extra vectors. We have the request IDs. Pasted cmd to pull logs: ```logs query --account VW-87 --from 2024-04-05T04:00Z --to 2024-04-05T04:15Z```
CollectionsBot: Automated reminder sent to billing@voltworks.com at 2024-06-20 09:12:02; thread linked.
Priya Nair: OK we should: 1) offer a conditional credit for the duplicate vectors only, 2) require VoltWorks acknowledgement of root cause and mitigations, 3) set a one-time manual hold on settlement until credit is applied.
LegalOps: Contract clause 5.2 covers usage disputes; credit issuance requires signed SOW amendment or confirmation email. We can accept a formal statement from VoltWorks legal.
Evan Cho: Proposed action: Draft credit memo for $21,150 (50% of disputed amount) to expedite, subject to their written acknowledgment. Ask for 7-day turnaround, otherwise move to collections and suspend API keys.
Liam O'Connor: I can prepare the credit memo and confirmation template. Also recommend we throttle their ingestion to protect platform while they fix their client. Suggest soft-limit of 200rps on embeddings for VW-87.
Priya Nair: Approve draft: credit memo + throttle + 7-day ack. Collections team, please pause escalation sequence while negotiation occurs.

Please confirm root-cause mitigations and sign the attached acknowledgement within 7 days to process credit and avoid service suspension." Link: https://redwood.app/pm/drafts/voltworks-credit-5120
